name: FastAPI official skill
description: Build and review FastAPI endpoints and dependencies.
why: The framework maintainer covers response validation, async versus blocking work, dependencies and streaming.

setup.label: Project scope
setup.detail: Use when the project uses FastAPI. Check the installed FastAPI and Pydantic versions against any suggested API.

cautions: Some guidance targets recent FastAPI APIs; preserve the project’s versions and conventions.
The skill suggests related tools; installing or migrating a dependency is a separate choice.

name: Python testing infrastructure
description: Review and build pytest and coverage infrastructure.
why: Examines config precedence, coverage-gate failures and multi-version test strategy rather than generating individual tests.

setup.label: Skill scripts
setup.detail: Includes a read-only script and reference files. The instructions use CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR; automatic installation is limited to Claude Code until other host support is verified.

setup.label: Project tools
setup.detail: The workflow uses the project’s Python and pytest; optional coverage, uv, Hypothesis and mutation tools are separate dependencies.

cautions: This is for requested test infrastructure, not a single bug fix. Thresholds and added tooling must fit the project.
Upstream commands use Claude-specific CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR; script invocation on other clients requires adapting the path.

name: Python packaging and artifacts
description: Review Python packaging configuration and built distributions.
why: Checks wheels and sdists, including missing typing markers and unintended files, and explains backend migration risks.

setup.label: Skill scripts
setup.detail: Includes a read-only script and reference files. The instructions use CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR; automatic installation is limited to Claude Code until other host support is verified.

setup.label: Project tools
setup.detail: Building requires the project’s Python build tooling; upstream examples use uv and optionally validate-pyproject.

cautions: Upstream defaults to uv and recommends layout/config migrations. Preserve the existing stack and do not remove config or lockfiles without a scoped migration.
Building or fetching dependencies has side effects; the archive checker itself is separate and read-only.
